samples.title: Every force is a wheelbarrow
samples.subject: Physical Sciences
samples.script: Load a wheelbarrow and push it across the yard. Feel that? Your push forward, the ground dragging back on the wheel, the earth holding it up, the load pressing down. Four forces - and you just drew your first free-body diagram without touching a pen. Now on paper: one dot for the barrow, one arrow for each thing acting on it. Push, friction, normal force, weight. Name them, point them the way you felt them. The physics was already in your hands; the diagram just writes it down.
